forecaster.architecture: Frozen 14B report encoder and learned scalar residual log-odds head
forecaster.feature_pooling: Mean of contextual final-token vectors over all complete report chunks, then L2 normalize
forecaster.selection: minimum dev Brier; ties favor zero or stronger regularization
forecaster.loss: mean binary log loss plus L2 penalty on all correction weights and intercept

evaluation_status: Repeated historical pilot, not a fresh final test. No test-driven configuration changes.
